behavior.objective: Bring ee_site within 0.05 m of the target at any control tick within 200 ticks, using the reach criterion from examples/demo_reach.py.

interfaces.actions: Two normalized joint-position targets in [-1, 1], mapped to shoulder and elbow actuator ctrlrange; 0.02 s control period, 0.002 s physics period.
interfaces.observations: Actor: joint positions, joint velocities, and ee-to-target vector (7 values). Critic adds ee position and distance (11). Uses simulator state; not a hardware sensor interface.

reset.training: Unchanged examples/demo_reach.py: JAX uniform qpos in [-0.4,0.4] rad, zero velocity, targets sampled at radius [0.12,0.34] m and angle [0,1] rad from shoulder in X-Z.
reset.native: The same MJX reset implementation and action mapping; evaluator replaces the sampled target with a fixed scenario target and rebuilds observations.

assumptions: Existing two-joint simple_arm.xml and demo_reach.py reward formula/termination; refresh derived kinematics after integration so they measure the actual final pose. 20 ms control, 2 ms physics, maximum 200 ticks.
Independent ee_site world position is recomputed from qpos with native MuJoCo forward kinematics, without reading reward or state.metrics.success.
Arrival within 5 cm at any post-step tick; sustained holding, collision safety, and hardware transfer are outside this existing task definition.
Promotion is a regression matrix. A separate holdout suite reserves previously unexamined reset seeds for the final corrected checkpoint; all fixed targets remain inside the training distribution.
Zero/random action and a 9 cm near-miss controller are controls, not learned policies. Random action may occasionally succeed; report every case without filtering.

outcomes.success: Post-step ee_site world-frame target distance < 0.05 m at least once within 200 control ticks. Runtime rejects non-finite states/actions. Full promotion requires every fixed case to succeed.
outcomes.failure: No physical target arrival, invalid numerical state/action, missing measurements, or evaluator failure. Contacts and holding are not assessed.
